title: Gentle gym week: weight loss + mobility
author: Elspeth Workout Bot
notes: Three short gym sessions a week plus your two aqua aerobics classes. Every gym session is the same shape: 10 min gentle warm-up, a few machines, a short walk in the pool, then 10 min in the jacuzzi. Pick a weight that feels comfortable for every rep, and you should finish each set feeling you could do 3-4 more. When 2 sets of 12 feels easy two sessions in a row, go up one notch on the machine. Move slowly, breathe out as you push, and stop anything that hurts (a bit of effort is fine, pain isn't). Ask a gym instructor to show you how to set up each machine the first time.

days.title: Gym A
days.focus: Legs, chest and back on machines
days.notes: About 45 min including the pool and jacuzzi.

exercises.name: Recumbent bike
exercises.notes: Easy pace, you should be able to chat

exercises.name: Sit to stand from bench
exercises.notes: Stand up from a bench without using hands if you can, sit down slowly

exercises.name: Pool walking
exercises.notes: Walk forwards, backwards and sideways in the shallow end

exercises.name: Jacuzzi
exercises.notes: Gently roll shoulders, ankles and neck while you relax

days.title: Gym B
days.notes: About 45 min including the pool and jacuzzi.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull bar to top of chest

exercises.name: Wall press-up
exercises.notes: Hands on wall, step feet back a little

exercises.name: Standing side leg raise
exercises.notes: Hold a rail or machine for balance

days.title: Gym C
days.notes: About 50 min including the pool and jacuzzi.

exercises.name: Treadmill walk
exercises.notes: Hold the rails if needed, add a slight incline when it feels easy
